sector: B2B Industrial Marketplaces, Manufacturing & Supply Chain

flagship_project.name: Project HyperFab-Global: Autonomous Industrial Manufacturing Operating System, Distributed CNC Telemetry & Real-Time BOM Arbiter
flagship_project.pillar: Distributed Industrial Manufacturing Cloud & Real-Time CNC/CMM Quality Telemetry
flagship_project.strategic_thesis: Global supply chains are decoupling from China, seeking precision manufacturing capacity across India and SE Asia. HyperFab-Global unifies 10,000+ distributed factory machine tools, providing instant CAD-to-BOM quotation, automated CNC toolpath optimization, and real-time IoT CMM quality compliance for aerospace and defense buyers.
flagship_project.tech_stack: Rust / C++ (CAD Geometry & Toolpath Analyzer), Go (Supply Chain Microservices), Apache Kafka, TimescaleDB (Factory Machine IoT Telemetry), PostgreSQL, React 19 / Three.js (3D Interactive CAD Viewer)
flagship_project.kpis: Automates 3D CAD quotation from 4 days to 45 seconds; maintains 99.9% dimensional accuracy tolerances across 10,000 supplier factories; manages $2B+ manufacturing pipeline.
